verdicts.reason: Cold-first max STA=861.063ms vs MTA=162.576ms (eliminates Notepad 446ms / Explorer 861ms cold STA init); mean warm p50: STA=65.94ms, MTA_Fresh=66.88ms, MTA_CachedRoot=69.69ms (parity=1.0).

verdicts.candidate: CacheRequest Tuning (Minimal Props / No TextPattern / No Bounds N+1)
verdicts.decision: DROP NoBounds+N+1; HOLD Minimal Props (DROP dropping BoundingRectangle)

verdicts.candidate: ControlView vs Explicit RawView vs OrCondition Interactive Filter
verdicts.decision: DROP RawView; HOLD OrCondition (Needs TabControl + Pattern Conditions)
verdicts.reason: TreeFilter verified == ControlViewCondition by default (not RawView). Explicit RawView inflates Chrome 66->254 nodes (92.3ms) with prec=0.4043; OrCondition min recall=0.9615 (omits TabControl 50018 & pattern-only custom controls).
